title: ONT Phage Assembly Pipeline (Nextflow DSL2)
description: Nextflow DSL2 pipeline for de novo assembly (Porechop_ABI, Filtlong, Flye), polishing (Medaka), reorientation (Dnaapler) and characterisation (PhaBOX2, Pharokka) of bacteriophage genomes from Oxford Nanopore R10.4.1 reads.
